### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/service-analytics`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`  _(via COPY (symbol, a top-level const object))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **68** of **251** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3d86e2cc40adcb213686e43416cb864ca062f938` — the merge of head `bf7199432678a81f7878fe8f969a54bb8a66e802` into base `0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3d86e2cc40adcb213686e43416cb864ca062f938 && git checkout 3d86e2cc40adcb213686e43416cb864ca062f938
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8 bf7199432678a81f7878fe8f969a54bb8a66e802 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8 && git merge --no-ff bf7199432678a81f7878fe8f969a54bb8a66e802

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0b2118f49c0f5b0a4b267b327bc8cfd257f182a8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

The test file and the changeset are the lane's and were read as evidence only.

### ① Derived judgments

- Check-runs on the head, second read at about 16:11Z: 52 runs. 25 completed `success`, 16 completed `skipped`, 11 `in_progress` (Test Core 1/10 to 10/10 and Build Core), 0 failed. Green among the completed: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, every Lint family (repo and tooling gates, docs and code guards, ESLint, PM dispatch-gates, CI/release/engine, the three scoped ones), every Type Check family (workspace, source gates, consumer gates, debt ledger). NOT YET ANSWERED on this head: the Test Core shards, which carry the rewritten and new pins in `dataset-tools.test.ts`, `skill-single-source-34686.test.ts` (mirror equals skill) and `initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`. The adopting seat reads them before it acts on this record.
- `list_datasets` output shape: unchanged. `decision`, `terms`, `matches`, `candidates` are computed as before; only which sentences `note` holds differs, in two branches. Right: no spec schema, enum or accept-set moves, and `note` is declared a free string (M1 note of 2026-11-17).
- `nextStep.note`, `no_measure` branch: with an unknown word among the words, the note ends in the fallback sentence alone; with every word a dimension hit it ends in the which-number sentence alone. Right against the jsdoc and the changeset.
- `nextStep.note`, `candidates_only` branch whose reported words are all possible groupings: the which-number sentence is written only when no word sent falls back. Right; the left-out sentences then carry the unknown word and its labelled fallback, as before.
- Unchanged and verified in the code: `several_measures`, `one_measure`, the measure-candidate question (`candidateHit` and `candidateTail`), the left-out sentences, the partial tail, all four locales' copy strings.
- `list_datasets` description: one sentence replaced. `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` is not edited and carries no dimension-alone sentence, so the two doors do not contradict each other; the sentence the two share ("A word whose candidates are all dimensions ...") is untouched.
- Skill: two table rows reworded, one clause under the table cut, one example added in step 1. The generated mirror changes in the same three places and reads identical to the skill at the head, hunk for hunk (read, not run; the gate that proves it is in the pending Test Core shards, and the `--check` form sits in the green lint families).
- Eval file: cases 21 to 23 appended, ids 1 to 23, no earlier case edited.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/34996-ask-fallback-beside-grouping.md`: `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch, `@objectstack/mcp` patch, `@objectstack/skills` patch. Each named package has a changed published file in the diff, and no changed package is missing. Patch is the right level: a behaviour fix in a served sentence and guidance text, no export, key, shape or accepted input added or removed. Check Changeset is green on the head.
- Clause-②: no, on the PR body and in the changeset, and the tree agrees: no file under `packages/spec`, no published schema, no declared capability taken away. `Metadata-protocol: none` agrees too.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Q1 (dev open question 2), answered on my own reading of ADR-0149: rule 4 governs a word for a thing measured that has no hit and no candidate, also when a grouping word beside it hits a dimension. The change is right for that case and is not graded as a blocking finding. Grounds, from the record itself: (a) rule 5 says a dimension hit "is not an answer" and that the AI "still needs a measure hit (or asks)"; its own example is a grouping with no number word, and in the mixed case the dimension hit is not used as the answer, the number comes from rule 4's fallback; (b) the note of 2026-11-17 says "With no candidate, rule 4 is unchanged" and that rule 4 "still governs" a term with no hit, and the note of 2026-11-19 lists "Rule 4, for a term with no hit and no candidate" under what does not change and calls rule 5's question "a question about the missing measure": a measure word that is present and unmatched is rule 4's case; (c) M2, ruled A, states its consequence as no regression in coverage, "answers everything it answers today": under the other reading, adding a `status` dimension to any dataset would turn an answered records question into a question back; (d) the skill on `main` already said it since PR #35038 ("go to step 4 instead of asking about some other word's matches"), and the executor's `one_measure` note already sends an unknown word to the fallback beside a grouping. The record does not say this in so many words, and D3 is carried by cloud's planner as well. Escalated, not blocking: ADR-0149 should gain an amendment note recording this reading, on a follow-up card, so the second consumer does not read rule 5 the other way. The limit of the reading is S1 below: where the question has no word for a thing measured, rule 5 governs, and the executor cannot see that.
- Q2 (dev open question 1), confirmed: a single measure candidate is still asked about and never selected, per ruling record 7024577075 and seat scope note 7032849227. In the diff, `asked`, `candidateHit`, `candidateTail` and `leftCandidateTail` are untouched; the only edited conditions gate `groupingTail`. The skill row "A word with a measure among its `candidates`" and the description's measure-candidate sentence are unchanged. The new pin holds the question beside an unknown word in four locales. The dev's recommendation A (keep the ruling, bring a re-ruling to the maintainer only on a count after a release) stands; the choice is the maintainer's.
- Dev flag, new row wording unmeasured: accepted as declared. The keep-or-drop of this change set is the eval seat's 5-rep round on a workspace build of this branch; this record does not stand in for it, and the PR stays draft until that round reports.
- Dev flag, ablation narrowed to a single-process probe, vitest red leg not measured: the lane seat's to accept or re-run; not a contract matter. The green leg is the pending Test Core shards.
- Dev flag, ratchet row 5 tokens above the file: the seat's call; the ratchet gate is green as it stands.
- Dev flag, executor cannot tell which word is the number word ("observation, not filed"): not accepted as an observation. It is S1.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join is added or changed. No finding.
- Security: no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour; the `membersWithheld` row and the hidden-records lines of the skill are untouched.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`. Holds against the spec it teaches and the card's scenarios. Row five is now keyed on what the client knows and the executor does not (whether the question has a word for a thing measured), and row six takes the fallback "without asking", which is rule 4 as read under Q1 and what the gallery items `orders_by_status` and `receivables_aging` need. The cut clause's content is in row six; "Ask only about matches or candidates for words the user wrote" still stands alone and is true. Step 1's counting head agrees with the eval reading 7041940806 and with the vocabulary the tree authors: every count measure in the example apps and both scenario cards declares "number of X" as a synonym and none declares the bare noun, so the whole phrase is the one that can equal a measure. Tried to break it with a several-match word beside an unknown word: row two still asks and the `several_measures` note says to compute nothing, the same tension the cut clause had on `main`, not a new one.

`skills/objectstack-ask/evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`. Case 21 quotes the note sentence for sentence as `composeDatasetNextStep` composes it at the head for a grouping candidate beside an unknown word (`groupingCandidateHit`, `groupingCandidateTail`, `unknownHit`, `leftFallbackTail`, no which-number sentence), with the `decision` and `terms` the executor reports. Case 22 is the dimension-hit form, and rightly refuses Open Balance as a reading by similarity. Case 23 is the first call with the whole counting phrase. Expected outputs agree with steps 1, 2 and 4 of the skill at the head, the dataset line of step 4 included.

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-next-step.ts`. The two edited conditions do what the jsdoc section says, checked case by case: under `no_measure` every reading is `no_measure`, so `reported.some(fallsBack)` is exactly "an unknown word is among the words"; under `candidates_only` with no asked word and no word that falls back, every word sent is a possible grouping or a dimension hit, which is the jsdoc's "every word sent equals only a dimension, or has only dimensions among its candidates". `fallsBack` is the predicate `leftOutSentences` already used, now named once. "One note never says both" holds for the which-number sentence and the fallback sentence in every branch.

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`. The replaced sentence agrees with the executor's two branches as written. It shares the overreach of S1.

`packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts`. Equals the skill at the head in all three changed places.

S1 (should-fix) — The executor, its jsdoc and the tool description treat every unknown word as the word for the thing measured; the skill does not, and for a question with no such word rule 5 still governs. A call whose words are a grouping that hits and an unknown word that is not a number word (a filter value or a second grouping no dataset lists: `["stage", "west region"]` for "break it down by stage for the west region") was told to fall back and to ask on `main`; at the head the note says only "Answer with the object query tools", the description says "beside a word that falls back it asks nothing, and the fallback stands", and the jsdoc says the fallback "computes the number the user named", which is false there: the user named none. The skill's row five says to ask in that same case and the skill also says to follow `note`, so the two served texts now disagree where on `main` they agreed. The PR body names this and files nothing. Smallest fix that keeps the measured gain: state the condition in the client's terms in `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION`, as the skill's rows do (the question is owed when no word names a thing measured; nothing is asked beside a word for a thing measured that falls back), and correct the jsdoc section to say the executor reads an unknown word as the number word and that the client's rule decides when it is not. The note's wording for that case can stay or gain a pin; if it stays, a follow-up card owns it. An eval case for the no-number-word mixed call would hold the skill side.

N1 (nit) — Eval assertions 21 to 23 forbid strings a correct reply may use in negation. Case 23 forbids `'claims'` and `"claims"`, while the skill's own step 1 teaches the contrast form ("number of deals", not "deals"): a reply that says the term is 'number of claims', not 'claims', fails the case. Cases 21 and 22 forbid "which number" the same way ("no need to ask which number"). This costs false fails in the with-skill arm, not correctness of the contract; loosen on the prose face or leave as an accepted deviation.

N2 (nit) — Case 22 expects a sum "of the balance field grouped by the aging bucket field" on `invoice`, and the prompt states no such fields; an aging bucket is commonly a computed dimension with no stored field. The expected output would read better conditioned on what `describe_object` shows. No effect on the contract.

Verdict basis: the reading the change rests on is the record's (Q1), the ruled ask-back is untouched (Q2), the implementing code agrees with its contract in the case the PR targets, and no finding blocks. S1 is open on this head and earns a delta review of its fix. The pending Test Core shards and the eval seat's round are named above and are not covered by this record.

## Contract review

### ① Derived judgments

- Check-runs on the head, both pages read: 53 runs, 37 `success`, 16 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 pending. Green at this head: Build Core, Test Core and its shards 1/10 to 10/10 (they carry the rewritten pins in `dataset-tools.test.ts`, `skill-single-source-34686.test.ts` and `initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`, which the prior record had to leave unanswered), Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, every Lint family, every Type Check family, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI.

The generated mirror differs from `main` in the same three hunks with the same text, line for line; the gate that proves it (`gen-mcp-ask-skill --check` in the lint families, `skill-single-source-34686.test.ts` in Test Core) is green at this head.

Each named package has a changed published file in the diff and no changed package is missing. Check Changeset is green on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Q1 (answered in the prior record: ADR-0149 D3 rule 4 governs a word for a thing measured with no hit and no candidate, also beside a dimension hit; rule 5 governs a question with no such word). The rework does not contradict that reading anywhere. The conditional sentence asks only "when the question has no word for a thing measured", which is rule 5's own case as the note of 2026-11-19 words it ("a question about the missing measure"); where the word is present and unmatched the condition is false and rule 4's fallback stands, with no question. The skill row "A word with a measure among its `candidates`" and the description's measure-candidate sentence are unchanged, and the pin holding the candidate question beside an unknown word in four locales now also holds that the conditional sentence is absent there.
- Dev flag, the conditional sentence is new wording no model round has read: accepted as declared, and named here as the one risk of the rework. The sentence puts the word "ask" back into the note of a question that named its number, which is the note the PR set out to clear of it. It is conditional and placed last, and whether a small model still over-asks on it is exactly what the eval seat's 5-rep round on a workspace build of this branch measures. This record does not stand in for that round, and the PR stays draft until it reports.
- Dev flag, PR body still describes the round-one head ("no copy string changes in any locale", "cases 21 to 23", 1872 tokens): this record judged the tree. The body is the seat's to rewrite before the PR is readied.
- Dev flags, ablation 5 narrowed to a single-process probe, and one local `@objectstack/mcp` suite failure in `mcp-file-tools.test.ts` (a wall-clock test the diff does not reach): the lane seat's; Test Core and all ten shards are green at this head.
- Dev note, eval cases 12 to 15 on `main` whose `expected_output` prose does not pass their own assertions: outside this diff, not reviewed; the grader reads assertions only, so nothing in this diff is misgraded by it.
- Rework report `open_questions`: none.
- SQL push-down: no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join is added or changed. No finding.
- Security: no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour; the `membersWithheld` row and the hidden-records lines of the skill are untouched.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

S1: closed — the three served texts and the jsdoc now agree in the case the finding named. For `["stage", "west region"]` the note composed at the head is the grouping sentence, the unknown-word sentence, the fallback sentence, then "Only when the question has no word for a thing measured, ask the user which number they mean instead."; the skill's row five says to ask for a question with only grouping or filter words, and the description states the same condition. A client that follows `note`, as the skill tells it to, asks. The jsdoc no longer claims the fallback computes a number the user named. The fix is in the note itself, pinned in four locales with three controls (grouping alone, unknown word alone, matched measure beside both), and eval case 24 holds the skill side.

N1: closed — cases 21 and 22 forbid the question as put to the user ("Which number do you", "Which number would you" and their lower-case forms), not the bare phrase, and case 23 forbids the cut-down word as a term sent, not the quoted word. Under the grader's literal-substring rule a correct reply that uses the old strings in negation, or the skill's own contrast form, now passes.

N2: closed — the dev's ground holds in the tree: `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json` stores `balance` and `aging_bucket` on every invoice seed row, the dataset's `open_balance` measure sums `balance` and its `aging` dimension reads `aging_bucket`. The scenario the case is accepted against has the stored fields; left as is.

`skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`. Holds. Row five is keyed on what only the client knows, and with "or filter words" it now covers the unknown word that is not a number word, which is the gap S1 named. Row six is unchanged from the prior head. Rows five and six partition the mixed call by one test (does the question have a word for a thing measured), the same test the note's closing sentence and the description use, in the same words. Tried to break it with a count question ("How many sales orders are in each status?"): "sales orders" is the word for the thing measured by step 1's own examples (商机数), row six applies, no question.
